verdict.rationale: Terraform works on many resources at once: a single plan/apply covers an entire configuration, and Terraform builds a resource graph and creates or modifies all non-dependent resources in parallel. Bulk runs can be automated non-interactively with -auto-approve and saved plans, with machine-readable JSON output for agents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of iteration constructs (count/for_each) for fanning out many similar items, bulk import or bulk state-manipulation details, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs beyond a general 'operations at scale' remark.
